items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Benny Moten came from around Kansas City.

ctx.x: And you don't mean Benny Moten, because that was before that.

Benny Moten came from around Kansas City. See, the St. Louis bands were t--they -- I -- you might consider them sort of like a band -- let's see, oh, I can't remember their names now. It's just not clear to me. I can go into the history and speak of it, but if you associate the year that I'm talking about with the band that you find in the history books, you would realize who I'm talking about. Fate Marabel was one of them.
